Package gui

Class TerminalIdentificationController

java.lang.Object
gui.TerminalIdentificationController
public class TerminalIdentificationController extends Object
Controller for the Terminal Identification screen. This screen is the entry point for the restaurant terminal, allowing users to identify themselves as subscribers or proceed as guests.
